subtype: Stage 1: Public teasing meets a raw spot [Receiver]
passage:
Class 10B group, 9:14 pm
Nirmala: who got 38 in maths 👀
Rehan: not me 😅
Nirmala: Tenzin bro your mom's gonna frame that paper
Rehan: 😆
Tenzin is typing…
Tenzin: at least I don't copy from the topper like some people
Tenzin: and it was 41 btw
Nirmala: ok chill it was a joke
Tenzin: your jokes are trash, like your handwriting
Rehan: ooooh
Tenzin stared at the screen. His thumbs had moved before his head did. The 41 was on his desk under his geometry box, and he had been avoiding it all evening, afraid it proved what he secretly thought: that he just wasn't good enough for science. If he stayed quiet now, everyone would decide the joke was true.

qa.q: Where was Tenzin's marked paper while he typed?
qa.a: The 41 was on his desk under his geometry box.

qa.q: Why did Tenzin reply so fast instead of staying quiet?
qa.a: He feared silence would make everyone decide the joke was true, and the paper had already made him afraid he wasn't good enough for science. 😟

qa.q: What could Tenzin do at this first moment to stop it growing?
qa.a: He could put the phone down for a few minutes, then reply calmly or message Nirmala privately that the joke hit a sore spot.

qa.q: How might Nirmala see Tenzin's reply?
qa.a: Nirmala seems to think it was only a joke, so the sharp reply may feel like an overreaction and push Nirmala to hit back too.

grounding: Shows a teenager teased about marks in a group chat, the joke landing on his fear of not being good enough, and his instant reply.

subtype: Stage 1: Public teasing meets a raw spot [Receiver]
passage: Kishan was pumping a tyre at his father's cycle shop in Sirsa when the phone on the counter buzzed three times. The tuition batch group. Jyoti had posted a photo of the notice board with the unit test marks, a circle around his name: 52. "Kishan bhai, see you in Class 11 again next year? 😄" Rehana added a laughing face. Something cold dropped in his stomach. His father always said the shop was waiting if studies didn't work out, and lately Kishan had started to wonder whether that was a joke or a plan. He wiped his greasy thumb on his shirt and typed fast: "Say that after your English result, Jyoti. Two tuitions and still 40?" He hit send before he could read it again.

qa.q: What mark was circled next to Kishan's name?
qa.a: The mark 52 was circled next to his name.

qa.q: What is Kishan afraid of when the teasing lands?
qa.a: It touches his worry that he isn't good enough for studies and may end up at the shop, which is why something cold dropped in his stomach.

qa.q: What could Kishan do before hitting send next time?
qa.a: He could finish the tyre first, reread the reply once, and choose silence plus a word to a friend, or a calm "That hurt, please take it down".

qa.q: How might Jyoti and Rehana react to Kishan's reply?
qa.a: Jyoti may feel shown up in front of the whole batch, and both may hit back, so the joke is likely to turn into a real fight.

grounding: Shows a teen boy teased about his marks in a group, the joke hitting his fear of not being good enough, and his quick reply.
